title: ArtifactContract
description: Declares what a task class must produce, how it is verified, and what happens on failure or rollback. One contract per task_class; referenced by task_class.artifact_contract_ref.

task_class.description: The task_class this contract governs. Must match task_class.schema.json name.

expected_artifact.description: The primary artifact kind this class produces. patch=git diff/PR, prose=markdown/doc, plan=structured plan doc, image=generated image, data=structured data file, composite=combination of the above.

success_verifiers.description: Ordered list of verifier names (must exist in verifier_contract registry) that all must pass for the artifact to be accepted. Evaluated in sequence; first fail short-circuits.

failure_policy.description: What to do when a verifier fails: request_changes (send back to implementer), escalate (open inbox item for human), rollback (invoke rollback_policy immediately).

rollback_policy.description: Name of the rollback procedure to execute when failure_policy=rollback or a hard-fail gate fires. Must reference a workflow node of type 'rollback' or a named rollback script.

artifact_path_template.description: Template for the expected output path. Supports {run_id}, {task_class}, {timestamp} substitutions. Used by verifiers to locate the artifact.

max_size_bytes.description: Maximum allowed artifact size in bytes. 0 = no limit.

retention_days.description: How many days to retain artifacts in artifact_memory before purging. 0 = retain indefinitely.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this contract enforces.
